'''Sirinek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Regnant]]'', the flagship of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the ''Regnant'' was infiltrated by Kirill's nemesis the [[Voidhound]] and Sirinek was killed trying to stop him from reaching the Admiral.
